name: causalpy-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is CausalPy, a Python library for causal inference in quasi-experiments. This task
covers its experiment classes (difference-in-differences, staggered difference-in-differences, interrupted time
series, piecewise interrupted time series, synthetic control, synthetic difference-in-differences, regression
discontinuity, regression kink, panel regression, pre/post non-equivalent groups, instrumental variables and inverse
propensity weighting) with their model backends, the effect-summary reporting layer, the scikit-learn models, the
formula transforms and helpers, and the sensitivity checks and pipeline steps.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is causalpy/__init__.py, causalpy/constants.py, causalpy/custom_exceptions.py, causalpy/formula_utils.py, causalpy/transforms.py, causalpy/utils.py, causalpy/skl_models.py, causalpy/reporting.py, causalpy/pipeline.py and every Python module under causalpy/experiments/, causalpy/checks/ and causalpy/steps/, together with the documentation pages README.md, every page under causalpy/skills/running-causalpy-experiments/reference/, causalpy/skills/running-placebo-analysis/reference/placebo_in_time.md, docs/source/knowledgebase/reporting_statistics.md, docs/source/knowledgebase/estimands.md, docs/source/knowledgebase/glossary.rst, docs/source/knowledgebase/design_notation.md, docs/source/knowledgebase/prediction-contract.md and docs/source/notebooks/sensitivi
